title: UpdateAnniversaryRequest
description: Complete Anniversary replacement plan with optimistic concurrency. expected_updated_at is the exact updated_at observed by the caller; C++ compares it inside the same logical transaction before replacing the Anniversary, its exclusively owned recurrence, templates, and affected Reminder chains. A mismatch returns ANNIVERSARY_UPDATE_CONFLICT and performs no write. reminder_plan omitted means preserve the complete existing plan; an object replaces it; explicit null is invalid. An empty templates array deletes every template, while reminders_enabled=false with non-empty templates pauses without deleting them.

expected_updated_at.description: Opaque optimistic-concurrency token copied unchanged from the Anniversary updated_at returned to the editor. A successful update must return a different token, including when two commits occur within one wall-clock second.

date.description: Replacement original date and, when recurring, the sole yearly month/day anchor.

recurrence.description: Yearly Anniversary recurrence intent, or null to make the Anniversary one-time. The client never sends recurrence_id; C++ decides whether to retain, create, or retire the owned rule.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used by C++ to derive the local date and calculate the response countdown.

reminder_plan.description: Missing preserves the current total switch and templates. Present replaces both. Null is forbidden.
